lines.2: 「Please, if you love me, just do what I say!」
lines.3: 「Are you planning to... hurt the Princess?」
lines.4: 「Huh? Of course I would never do that to my best friend.」
lines.5: 「But best friends are equals, right? So I just want Ellie to become the same as me!」
lines.7: In the end, that momentum swept me along.
lines.8: The Princess would be arriving soon, so I was shut inside the wardrobe.
lines.10: But I could just barely see what was happening outside.
lines.11: Yoshimi hid my shoes and tidied the room.
lines.12: 「You like uniforms, right, Leo? Leave it to me.」
lines.14: She had even gone out of her way to change into her uniform.
lines.17: 「Sorry, I'm a little late. I had some things to finish up at school. Being student council president is rough.」
lines.18: My heart gave a hard thump.
lines.19: 「Why are you in your uniform too, Yoppi?」
lines.20: 「Oh, I had to go see a relative for a bit.」
lines.22: 「I'm glad you invited me, Yoppi. You've been glued to Tsushima-kun lately and leaving me out.」
lines.23: 「I haven't been leaving you out. Ellie matters to me in a completely different way from Leo.」
lines.24: 「Then answer your phone when I call.」
lines.26: The Princess and Yoshimi chatted together.
lines.28: They just looked like two perfectly close friends.
lines.29: 「Sorry, Ellie. Yesterday I said things like 'don't make eyes at Leo.' I was confused...」
lines.30: 「Hm? Oh, that. No problem. I don't care at all.」
lines.31: The Princess brushed it off completely.
lines.32: That easygoing side of her was one of the things I liked about her too.
